One In Him · UI/UX review

Captured from the live release 228 on 18 October 2026. These are BEFORE screenshots. Fixes are prepared in PR #2, not deployed. Desktop captures are 1348–1363 px wide; the user supplied the phone screenshot. This is not a completed mobile or accessibility certification.

The main defects are inconsistent dark-surface styles and controls that promise an action the app does not complete. Navigation, explicit coming-soon states and search recovery are useful foundations.

1. Discover

Mostly usable; content gaps

Clear primary feature and navigation. Several coming-soon cards and supporter promises still need content readiness checks. No change to paid access or billing.

2. Account

Fixes prepared

The divider is the header border. The supplied phone screenshot also shows dark icons on the same dark header. Removed the border/shadow and set visible icon colours. Zero completed lessons now says Start your journey. Closed registration no longer presents an unusable form.

3. Watch

Usable; detail issue below

Shelves open correctly. Coming-soon cards are explicitly disabled. No new functional issue confirmed in this shelf.

4. Message detail

Fixes prepared

Start this lesson wrongly implies a companion lesson for an unlinked sermon. The existing review change uses Watch message and a separate journey option. Back to browse now sizes to its label instead of spanning the whole screen.

5. Listen

Usable; content gaps

Navigation works. The small catalogue repeats the same items across shelves and includes a planned audiobook. Content and media availability need editorial review; playback was not tested.

6. Feed

Contrast fix prepared

Post text and milestone copy explicitly used black on dark bubbles. Set readable light text on those children. The preview/local-only disclosure and Save thought label are clear; real community publishing remains unavailable.

7. Journey overview

Copy/action fix prepared

The Save your progress card promised notes across devices but its action shared a lesson. Replaced that with device-storage copy and View my progress, which opens Account. This does not add cloud note sync.

8. Start unit

Functional fix tested

Clicking Start unit at 0% left the live page unchanged. The handler rejected any zero-progress unit unless it was a guided target. It now allows the current unlocked unit. Regression checks exercise the actual button and retain the later-unit lock.

9. Podcast browsing

Existing review fix confirmed necessary

The live Podcast Shows page includes courses, documentaries and duplicate One Basics artwork. Existing review changes restrict it to podcast shows, group episodes and retain mobile labels. Live desktop screenshot and the user-provided mobile screenshot support this finding.

10. Search

Polish/accessibility fixes prepared

No-results text, Clear search and Back work. The filter rail had an unnecessary vertical scrollbar and a bright divider; corrected overflow and spacing, enlarged filter targets, matched the orange selected indicator, and exposed selection with aria-pressed.

Verification and limits

npm test passes, including zero-progress unit entry, retained later-unit locks, registration gating, bilingual screens, account isolation, search selection, podcast grouping, completion persistence and email content rules. The stylesheet parses successfully and git diff --check passes.

The managed local preview remains unavailable because its sandbox cannot mount /proc. Updated mobile snapshots are static markup/styles, not browser screenshots of the changes. Live media playback, real signup and email delivery, keyboard/screen-reader coverage, actual iPhone safe-area rendering and production smoke tests remain pending. Signup and email delivery stay gated off.
